positive_terms: Disclosure of GHG removals and storage resulting from projects developed in own operations or contributed to in upstream and downstream value chain
运营和价值链中的温室气体移除与储存项目

Disclosure of GHG removals and storage resulting from projects developed in own operations or contributed to in upstream and downstream value chain。运营和价值链中的温室气体移除与储存项目。移除、储存、逆转、移除活动相关排放和碳信用各自独立；运营/价值链与价值链外项目分开，核销、计划核销和已售出不得混同。不能从毛排放减去碳信用生成本条事实。
